title: UW Verification Receipt 1.0
description: A detached JSON document binding a canonical digest of an underwriting record to the deterministic outputs a named calc pack produced from it. Normative definition: UW_RECEIPT_v1.md (RFC 0016). A receipt attests that the stated outputs follow from the record's canonical financial content — it attests nothing about whether that content is true.

receipt_version.description: Receipt document version. Independent of format, protocol, and package versions.

subject.description: Which record this receipt is about, and by which canonical form it is identified.

canonicalization.description: Named canonical form the digest covers. `uw-lite-financial` is UW_LITE_SPEC §6; `uw-envelope-semantic` is the Document Envelope 1.0 semantic value under RFC 8785.

digest.description: SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 bytes of the named canonical form.

computation.description: Which deterministic pack ran, on which engine, and what it produced.

pack.description: Calc pack manifest id, e.g. org.uwmd.pack.multifamily.

pack_version.description: Semver of the pack manifest. A pack with no version cannot be named here.

results.description: Exactly the outputs the named pack declares — no more, no fewer. Never a place for hand-entered numbers.

results_digest.description: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 canonicalization of `results`. A cheap corruption check only — a verifier MUST recompute rather than trust it.

policy.description: Which policy set was applied, and what it found.

issuer.description: Identity of the issuing tool, e.g. uwmd-cli@1.1.3. Not an assertion of authority.

signature.description: Optional detached signature over the RFC 8785 canonicalization of this receipt with `signature` set to null. Same wire shape as RFC 0010 block signatures. Key distribution is out of scope.

value.description: The pack's output. MUST be null when `computed` is false.

computed.description: False when the pack declares this output but the record lacks the inputs to produce it. Distinguishes 'not computed' from 'computed to null'.
